_comment: Which MCP tools a Magpie family's skills call, so their permission allows can be derived
instead of granted to everyone. setup adopt/upgrade write the allows for the families in
.apache-magpie.lock into the committed .claude/settings.json (a derived key, like
enabledPlugins); reconciliation adds the allows for families installed only on one machine
to .claude/settings.local.json. List tools that read one named item or report state only:
a tool that sends, posts or deletes, creates a draft, or searches a whole mailbox or list
stays behind the harness prompt and never belongs here, because these sessions read
untrusted content and the operator should see those calls.
The claude_ai_Gmail entries are reads; drafting goes through gmail-plaintext, which writes
plain text with no tracking links.
